description:
In Episode 111 is Part 1 of this 2 part series (Ep 112 is part 2) and we discuss the effects of the war between Ukraine and Russia on the world at large. Basically there is no one that will not be impacted by it.  When we look at it through the prophetic lens we see that there is more to this than meets the eye. What is going on and where could this possibly be leading?
